obligations.statement: Nogoods: filter_𝒩 commutes with ⊕, is a sub-homomorphism for ⊗ (must be applied after composition), never revives a DEAD interval, and a violated CONSTRAINT's nogood kills every composite over both claims.

Procedure algebra (; , ⊗_w, if, bounded loop): trace warrant = ⊗ over fired primitives/tests; static warrant ≤ trace warrant (LIVE(static) ⇒ LIVE(trace)); iteration idempotent; guard composes with the taken branch in the trace reading and with both in the static reading; a LearnedProcedure records its reading.
obligations.limitation: exhaustive over antichains at n=3 on a choice program and a bounded loop

obligations.statement: Statistical/neural operator outputs enter as ⟦0,U⟧ (UNKNOWN) with the score outside the lattice; they become LIVE only through an exact-checker certificate or a scoped coverage certificate whose scope is recorded; no composition of all-UNKNOWN components is LIVE.

obligations.limitation: definitional half only; graded exact-share retraction stays OPEN

obligations.statement: Seed-count lemma: the expected fixed point over uniformly random seed supports of any size equals the uniform-seed fixed point (linearity of a* in s); the PROPAGATED surprise model (propagated mass vs propagated background) preserves KS-T06/T06b.
obligations.limitation: the model comparison (38→47/50) is a dev-split design-choice study; default unchanged

obligations.statement: OCMEvent chain: event_id is not its own hash input; sequence contiguous, prev_hash continuity, recomputed content hash; resource_delta structurally non-optional and summed on replay (S7 over the log); four distinct CAS expectation errors.

obligations.statement: Commit boundary: intent logged before any effect; execution only if warrant LIVE ∧ hard gates PASS ∧ external authority granted; CANNOT_CHECK never becomes success; the runtime cannot grant itself commit authority (undeclared coordinate = bottom).

obligations.limitation: authority is a host-injected object, not a signature

obligations.statement: Learner lifecycle: feedback yields behaviour proposals only unless a registered FeedbackContract routes it as an OBSERVATION of a registered outcome function; ambiguous stays unresolved; contradictions are preserved as conflicts; a promoted object's warrant is the exhibited evidence so revoking an essential lesson reopens it while unrelated skills stay live; relearning keeps lineage.

obligations.statement: Evidence dependence: derived evidence carries its own interval; a citation's warrant is ⊗ of the cited records' intervals; revocation is assumption-only; sources sharing an assumption never count twice.
